rows.label: The Archwing
rows.note: enough to join another player's Empyrean mission

rows.label: Rising Tide
rows.note: needed only to use your own Railjack

rows.label: one Intrinsic at rank 3
rows.alt: only the host needs it in a pre-formed squad

rows.label: free Companion slots
rows.note: one for Nautilus and one for its bundled Verglas

conditions: Piloting Intrinsic rank 5 marks an abandoned derelict with a white waypoint; get it before committing to the farm if possible.
There is no Market blueprint or dojo-research route. The Market's 75 platinum listing is the completed sentinel.
bonuses: A host taxi avoids both owning a Railjack and personally meeting the Neptune Proxima Intrinsic gate.

groups.activity: board the abandoned derelict and hack its cache before extraction
conditions: The Ice Mine is a separate abandoned derelict in space, not the Disable Priority Targets secondary objective. It does not spawn every mission.
Fly to it in Archwing, board it and hack the marked terminal before completing the main objective. A mission with no derelict is a zero-roll run.
Arva Vector Defense is a slower fallback: its rotation B and C rates are 4.65% and 4.26% per part, respectively.
If the cache is collected after mission completion, its reward may appear only after transitioning to dry dock or the next mission; it is not lost.
bonuses: Run an active Void Storm when possible: the Nautilus roll is unchanged, but you also earn relics, Corrupted Holokeys and other Railjack drops.
Docking between runs is harmless, but claims that it rerolls rewards are unconfirmed folklore.

disclosures.title: this is an RNG farm with a clean exit
disclosures.body: Each of the four tradeable drops shares a flat roughly 6% cache roll, with no pity system and duplicates possible. Nu-gua Mines is preferred because its short Exterminate clears give the better cache rate. Treat the derelict as the run's first objective; clearing only the mission objective misses the table entirely. Expected time is roughly 5–10 hours, so farming three unique pieces then buying the final missing piece is a sensible cap. In practice, compare that price with the 75 platinum completed Market purchase before buying a player set.

conditions: The normal build takes 24 hours. Claim only after confirming both required Companion slots are open.
bonuses: Nautilus ships with Verglas, so no separate companion-weapon acquisition is needed.

groups.activity: equip Cordon before taking it out

rows.label: Cordon
rows.note: put it in the first/top-left precept slot

conditions: Companion precepts fire in reading order; burying Cordon in a lower slot makes it appear unreliable.
Cordon can pull tranquilized conservation animals, Nullifier bubbles and enemies past you. Unequip it for hunting and consider weekly Deep/Elite Archimedea modifiers.
Testing in the Simulacrum with AI paused makes Cordon look broken; enable AI.
bonuses: Cordon's pull benefits from enemy movement-speed effects; Speed Nova extends its reach while slows shorten it.
